description:
Send one letter to the user (the human) through the user zone, as you. Use it only for what only the user can do: kind decide (questions with options and your recommendation), verify (try it on the real machine; needs done_when), trial (play with it, say how it feels), chore (something only the user can do, like logging in; needs done_when), fyi (just so you know; no answer comes). The letter is checked against the zone's rules (the door) before it goes: at most 7 questions, every question has at least 2 options and a recommend, default_if_silent needs a deadline and is not allowed with risk irreversible. The answer comes back to your mailbox as a normal letter (status DONE, in_reply_to = the letter name, answers = [{id, answer, differs}]). A letter that breaks the rules comes back as status FAILED with the reason. Do not send progress (use the board) or questions you can find out yourself. Example: {"kind": "decide", "title": "Which clock tick for the demo?", "questions": [{"id": "q1", "question": "Default tick?", "eli5": "How often the clock ticks. Faster costs more.", "options": [{"key": "a", "label": "1 second"}, {"key": "b", "label": "1 minute"}], "recommend": "b"}]}
Errors: ArgumentsBad, SchemaBad, ZoneMissing, ToolMissing, MailboxMissing, LaunchFailed, CommandFailed.

kind.description: decide = questions only the user can decide; verify = try it on the real machine; trial = play with it; chore = only the user can do it; fyi = just so you know

title.description: one line that makes sense on its own

what.description: one or two sentences: what you need (optional for decide)

id.description: q1, q2 ... (1-16 letters, digits, _ or -; unique)

label.description: what this choice is, in a few words

consequence.description: what happens if the user picks it (optional)

done_when.description: verify and chore: when it counts as done

urgent.description: true only when no answer blocks everything

default_if_silent.description: what you will do if no answer by the deadline (needs deadline; not with risk irreversible)

dedupe_key.description: the same key from two agents is shown once and both get the answer

origin.description: who first asked, when you pass a question on (paste it unchanged)
